invariants.rationale: getImage always returns a new TextureRegion which should not be null.
The TextureRegion returned is constructed directly from images.get(name).
If name is in the map, images.get(name) is not null, resulting in a non-null TextureRegion texture.
If the underlying texture is not null, the region width matches the texture width.
If the underlying texture is not null, the region height matches the texture height.
